Plan completed: fix(pipeline): heartbeat orphan + PR diff false-negative + drift detection silent skip

Three related bugs to fix:

1. HEARTBEAT ORPHAN (.github/workflows/shipwright-pipeline.yml lines 625-631):
   Add SIGTERM trap + background sleep pattern so orphaned sleep is killed cleanly when
   the heartbeat subshell receives SIGTERM. Mirror the exact pattern from commit 1a21406.
   Current: (while true; do sleep 600; ...; done) &
   Fix: (trap 'kill %1 2>/dev/null; exit 0' TERM; while true; do sleep 600 & wait $!; ...; done) &

2. _safe_base_diff FALSE NEGATIVE (scripts/lib/pipeline-stages.sh lines 147-151):
   Add origin/$branch middle-tier fallback before HEAD~5. In GHA, main is only available
   as origin/main (not local ref). This causes _safe_base_diff to fall back to HEAD~5,
   which only sees the last 5 commits (all .claude/ artifacts), causing PR stage to
   falsely reject real branches as having no changes.
   Add stderr warn when final HEAD~5 fallback is used.

3. COUPLED DRIFT DETECTION GUARD (scripts/lib/pipeline-stages-review.sh lines 42-49):
   The drift detection function has its own git rev-parse --verify guard that silently
   returns 0 (skips) when main is not a local ref. Same root cause as bug 2. Fix: update
   the guard to also accept origin/$_base before returning 0. Update the comment which
   currently documents the old broken behavior.

TDD REQUIREMENT: Write tests first for each fix before implementing. For bug 1, write a
shell smoke test that verifies no orphan sleep after kill. For bugs 2 and 3, write tests
that simulate the GHA environment (main not a local ref, only origin/main exists).

ARCHITECTURE NOTE: _safe_base_diff has 11 callers across pipeline-stages-delivery.sh (10x)
and pipeline-stages-review.sh (4x). Fix is in the function itself so all callers benefit.
Do not change callers.
